author: Insta360
description:
Everything you need to build the ultimate Insta360 X5 motovlogging setup, from camera settings and mounts to the full edit. This Insta360 X5 motovlog tutorial walks through the complete motorcycle filming workflow, so whether you call it a motovlogging camera setup or a motorcycle vlog rig, you can capture immersive, cinematic ride footage every time you head out.

Creator @JayJankulovski covers when to use ND filters, how to dial in your X5 settings for different riding conditions, and how to nail both POV helmet shots and third-person chase angles. Then we jump into Insta360 Studio for reframing, stabilization, stitching, export settings, and a clean color grading workflow.

Whether you ride daily, shoot cinematic travel content, or just want sharper motorcycle footage, this guide will help you get the most out of Insta360 X5 from capture to final cut.
